force_accuracy_contract.postrun_gate: Verify the residual scale remains 1 for every accepted row and separately compare measured free_force_imbalance_l2_N/max_N; no force-accuracy conclusion can be made from this prepared command.
force_accuracy_contract.units_and_condition: For this pure mechanical coupon, source runtime forms certificate as generalized residual impulse norm divided by max(reference scale, 1). While the denominator remains 1, certificate is numerically an N s residual; divided by dt it gives the equivalent force bound.

refined_path_checks.interpretation: Underlying prescribed angular path and physical angular rate are unchanged. Per-step chord velocities differ at the expected O(dt^2) sampling level because the same curved rotational path is more finely sampled.

source_clock.release_flags: fillTargets marks right grip free in both release and post_release_relaxation phases

telemetry_caveat.detail: fillTargets sets right-grip target w=2 (free) for release and post_release_relaxation, while writeObservation emits right_grip_constrained=0 only when phase == release and emits 1 for post_release_relaxation. Treat this CSV field as incorrect for post-release; derive the grip mode from authored phase/target code and the retained requested phase counts.
